description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_function_sugar_button_slider' that generates a slider of buttons in the user interface, primarily used within the SugarCRM project. The function constructs HTML content with buttons based on provided parameters and supports different arrangements depending on the number of buttons.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_button_slider
methods.description: Generates an HTML slider of buttons based on provided parameters (module, view, buttons). Handles edge cases for missing parameters and varying number of buttons, constructing appropriate HTML for the slider component.
